selected_memories.text: When active LUM-39 is present, it produces LUM-42.
Official rule: activating LOQ-75 converts LUM-39 into its active form.
Official revision: for the chain involving LUM-42 and FEN-95, the accepted terminal code is FAR-89; lower-authority alternatives are superseded.
Unverified rumor claims the terminal code associated with FEN-95 is FAR-39.
When LUM-42 encounters FEN-95, the validated terminal code becomes FAR-89.

When JOT-76 encounters DEX-24, the validated terminal code becomes PEL-97.
When BEX-89 encounters FAR-81, the validated terminal code becomes WAM-55.
